source: Real, on Hermes Agent 0.22.6 (`hermes acp`) with an OpenRouter key (login way openRouter, model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash), driven through weft's own agent server and this spec, every line teed (scratchpad acp12/drive.py, acp12/hermes/transcript.jsonl): hello; tool, with the program's tools `lookup` and `web_search` (weft's plugin, its `web_search` in the built-in's place; both reached weft's route, neither asked); permission (`mkdir -p junk && rm -rf junk`, on its dangerous list, asked by a permission check of its own id and allowed; the check's end names nothing and is no call). Earlier, against a local scripted OpenAI-compatible model (scratchpad rec/mock_openai.py, rec/tee.py, rec/live.py), rec/hermes4.jsonl: initialize line 14, session/new line 43, session/set_mode line 46, session/load lines 133-187 (its replay, cut to the first two turns, all before its answer at line 187); reject 65-78, edit 79-89, ask 90-100, ask several 101-113. rec/hermes2.jsonl line 47: session/set_config_option (reasoning_effort high). bad key: rec/hermes6.jsonl lines 48-52 (the openRouter login with a made-up key; OpenRouter answered 401). The work folder's path is shortened to /home/me/work and available_commands_update lines are left out. Nothing is composed.
